boss-loot-assets-free.title: Animation for
boss-loot-assets-free.hiddenTargetHintDe: Tokens are invisible until the animation from this sequence is played.
boss-loot-assets-free.waitUntilFinishedS: If the checkbox is disabled, the sound will start at the same time as the animation.
boss-loot-assets-free.commandDesc: Write a command or drag & drop a Macro here:

boss-loot-assets-free.migration.title: BLFX Migration Required
boss-loot-assets-free.migration.contentPhrase1: An important update is available that requires migrating your item animations to the latest version.
boss-loot-assets-free.migration.contentPhrase2: This migration will update your item animations to be compatible with new features and improvements.
boss-loot-assets-free.migration.contentPhrase4: {boldStart}Note{boldEnd}: This process will overwrite any customizations made directly to the macros, so always remember to {boldStart}back up your data{boldEnd}.
boss-loot-assets-free.migration.errorMessage1: An error occurred during migration. Please check the console for details.

boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.title: BLFX Transfer Animations
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.contentPhrase1: {boldStart}Free to Premium.{boldEnd} Transfer your custom animations from the Free version to the Premium version!
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.contentPhrase2: After transfer, consider using {boldStart}Migrate Items{boldEnd} to enhance your animations with the latest features, like sound.
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.contentPhrase3: {boldStart}DnD v3 to DnD v4.{boldEnd} Transfer animations from DnD5e v3 to DnD5e v4. Note that this process is best effort and it will work only for items that have one animation and one activity!
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.contentPhrase4: Animations from all tokens in all scenes and all items in the Items sidebar will be included in the process.
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.button2Label: Transfer Animations (DnD5e v3 to DnD5e v4)
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.uiNotification1: There are no animations to transfer!
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.uiNotification2: MidiQoL is not active, nothing to transfer!
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.uiNotification3: This option can be used only for D&D5e-v4, nothing to transfer!
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.uiNotification4: Could not transfer item {itemName} to v4
boss-loot-assets-free.transfer.errorMessage1: An error occurred during animation transfer. Please check the console for details.
